title: ACS 2019–2023 5-year Data Profiles (DP02–DP05): St. Petersburg city, Florida
measures: Population, age (under 18, 65+, median age), households, language spoken at home, English ability, bachelor's degree share, median household income, mean travel time to work, no health insurance coverage, SNAP receipt, owner occupancy. title: ACS 2019–2023 5-year, B25004 Vacancy Status and B25001 Housing Units: four Florida cities and four counties
geography: St. Petersburg, West Palm Beach, Boca Raton and Sarasota cities; Pinellas, Palm Beach, Sarasota and Manatee counties
measures: Housing units vacant 'for seasonal, recreational, or occasional use' (B25004_006) divided by total housing units (B25001_001). Share computed by the editorial team.
limitations: Counts housing units, not people; does not measure how many seasonal residents are present at any time or whether they seek dental care locally.

title: ACS 2019–2023 5-year, C16001 Language Spoken at Home (population 5+): four Florida cities
geography: St. Petersburg, West Palm Beach, Boca Raton and Sarasota cities, Florida
measures: Population 5+ by language group spoken at home (Spanish; French, Haitian or Cajun; other Indo-European; etc.). Shares computed by the editorial team.
limitations: Grouped language categories (e.g. 'French, Haitian, or Cajun' and 'Other Indo-European' are not single languages); speaking a language at home is not a preference for marketing in it.

title: ACS 2019–2023 5-year Data Profiles: Pinellas, Palm Beach, Sarasota and Manatee counties, Florida
geography: Pinellas, Palm Beach, Sarasota and Manatee counties, Florida
measures: Share 65+, median age, language other than English at home, Spanish at home, median household income, no health insurance coverage, mean travel time (DP02, DP03, DP05).
limitations: ACS 5-year estimates with margins of error; city (place) figures, not county or metro.

title: Annual Estimates of the Resident Population for Incorporated Places and Counties in Florida: April 1, 2020 to July 1, 2025 (Vintage 2025, SUB-EST2025)
publisher: U.S. Census Bureau, Population Estimates Program
measures: Estimates base April 2020 and July 1 estimates 2020–2025 for St. Petersburg, West Palm Beach, Boca Raton, Sarasota and Tampa cities and Pinellas, Palm Beach, Sarasota and Manatee counties. Percentage changes computed by the editorial team.
limitations: Model-based estimates revised each vintage; not a count of patients; do not explain causes of change.

title: National Hurricane Center Tropical Cyclone Report: Hurricane Helene (AL092024)
geography: Florida Gulf coast incl. Pinellas, Manatee and Sarasota counties
measures: Storm surge, fatalities and structural damage reported in Pinellas, Hillsborough, Manatee and Sarasota counties, September 2024.
limitations: Damage figures compiled from media and emergency managers; describes one storm, not future risk.

title: National Hurricane Center Tropical Cyclone Report: Hurricane Milton (AL142024)
geography: Florida west coast, Sarasota and Tampa Bay areas
measures: Landfall on Siesta Key on 10 October 2024 as a category 3 hurricane; major damage in the Sarasota and Tampa Bay areas; area previously affected by Helene two weeks earlier.
limitations: Report notes damage assessments were complicated by the earlier storm.
